title: Hospital discharge and moving between services
summary: How people are supported safely when they come home from hospital or move to or from another service.
whenToUse: Every six months, or after a difficult discharge, a readmission or a medicines mix-up after hospital.

statements.focus: Discharge information received, care restarted on time and the care plan updated.
Medicines reconciled against the hospital discharge list before carers support them.
Contact with the hospital, GP and community teams around the move.
Needs reassessed after a hospital stay.
The person and family kept informed about when care starts again and who is coming.
